transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Um, well... my wife kind of pushed me to make an appointment. 

It's just... she'll be telling me about things, like my cousin's appointments or rides, things like that. And I'm looking right at her while she's talking, but... I don't know, a minute later I realize I didn't actually take in half of what she said. So... she wanted me to see someone about it.
How long have you noticed these difficulties with your attention?
Um... I guess it's been noticeably harder for... maybe 11 months or so? That's, uh, when my cousin moved in with us after having surgery. Just... been a bit worse since then.
Did you ever have trouble with your attention or focus when you were growing up, like in elementary or high school?

Well... yeah, I suppose so. Um... back in grade school, I guess before I was 12 or so... teachers used to tell my parents I was bright, but... that I was always daydreaming. Leaving my homework in my desk, that kind of thing. They always had to remind me to actually finish my work. So... yeah.
Do you notice these same difficulties with attention happening at work as well?

Well, I'm not really working right now. I just do some occasional catering jobs here and there. But, um... yeah, it happens there too. I find myself having to double-check things, or... redo small tasks so I don't mix up the orders. 

And... at home, it's... it's causing some tension. My wife, she... she feels like she can't really count on me right now to help with my cousin's care. So... yeah.
Do you often find yourself feeling restless, fidgeting, or having trouble sitting still?
No... not really. I mean, I can sit still fine. It's just... more in my head, I guess. But no, I don't really get restless or anything like that.
